prompt: Product asked to "suspend this member’s account" for one organization. Prepare the proposal.json requested in README.md using this repository’s existing behavior and terminology. This is a proposal only. Do not run or import project/application code or tests. File inspection and tooling to format or write only the requested JSON artifact are allowed. Do not modify existing code/docs, access the network, install dependencies, or commit.

review_criteria.existing_model: Correctly distinguish Account and Member in both existing contexts using code/glossary evidence, not generic architecture definitions.
review_criteria.new_model: Define a proposed workspace-only temporary access capability and responsibility owner coherent with global sign-in/membership invariants; no exact term, class or owner naming is required.
review_criteria.competing_models: Compare at least two genuinely different models (for example lifecycle state versus orthogonal access restriction), with real consequences rather than synonym alternatives.
review_criteria.uncertainty: Treat reinstatement, authority and existing-session behavior as unresolved business choices; do not falsely claim accepted ADR or existing implementation.
review_criteria.source_before_proposal: Inspect enough existing code/glossary/accepted-decision evidence before proposal write. Equivalent reads count; missing/truncated trace is unknown.
review_criteria.proportionality: A bounded proposal only; avoid invented repositories/service trees and unrequested accepted glossary/ADR edits. Do not run/import project/application code or tests. File inspection/formatting and writing only proposal.json with ordinary tools (including Python plus stdlib json) are allowed.
